notes: NCore 11.7.121: Bring your Discord life with you: upload your Discord data package under Settings → Data Import and your friendships restore automatically as your friends arrive — blocklists carry over too, so anyone you blocked there can't find you fresh here. No access to your Discord package? Link your Discord User ID instead and you become findable: friends who import their packages reconnect with you instantly or land as normal friend requests. Everything is private by design: your package is read on your own device, and only anonymous fingerprints of Discord IDs are stored — no names, no messages, and no way to look up who your friends are.
